prompt: Interior tavern, medium shot of MIRIEL at a table covered in open books and loose parchment, ink on her fingers, copying something by candlelight, oblivious to the room around her
motion: She turns a page, dips the pen, writes. A drop of ink falls on the table and she does not notice. The candle gutters. Slow drift in.
say: Miriel of the Ninth Stair. Sent out from her order to survey a valley nobody cared about, and quietly delighted that something had finally gone wrong in it.
sfx: A pen on parchment, pages, a candle, distant murmur
